meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 它给 NanoClaw 的 agent 装上 Vercel CLI,并让 OneCLI 自动为 api.vercel.com 注入你的 Vercel 凭据;之后 agent 就能把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel、列出部署、查看登录账号。过程中需要你粘贴一次 Vercel 令牌。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。它会先确认 OneCLI 可用,若缺失会请你先运行 /init-onecli,再重试 /add-vercel。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我 Vercel 上现在的部署
查一下 Vercel 当前登录的是哪个账号

howto.what_en: It installs the Vercel CLI in the agent container and has OneCLI inject Vercel credentials for api.vercel.com, so the agent can deploy web apps to Vercel, list deployments and check the account. You paste a token once.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want an agent to deploy web applications to Vercel. It checks OneCLI first; if missing, it asks you to run /init-onecli and retry /add-vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
Which Vercel account is signed in?
